 VETO secures SAFF Championship 2026 streaming rights, Ind-Pak clash set for Nov 5
 The tournament features six teams, with India, Pakistan and the Maldives in Group A, while Bhutan, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka make up Group B.
 afaqs! news bureau 
 03 Nov 2026 
 11:27
 IST Follow Us
 New Update VETO has secured the streaming rights to the SAFF Championship 2026, which will be held from November 5 to 17.
 The India-Pakistan fixture is scheduled for November 5 at 3 PM IST. The tournament features six teams, with India, Pakistan and the Maldives in Group A, while Bhutan, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka make up Group B.
 Commenting on the announcement, Ritu Dhawan, managing director, VETO, said: “Live sports have the ability to bring audiences together, and fixtures such as India vs Pakistan generate tremendous excitement among fans. With the SAFF Championship 2026 joining our sports portfolio, we aim to bring more international sporting action to Indian households through a subscription-free viewing experience.”
 The SAFF Championship joins VETO's existing live sports offering, which includes cricket, football, weightlifting and tennis. The platform said its sports offering currently covers more than 300 hours of live content.
 The final is scheduled for November 17.
